amendments.body: `crates/tank_core/src/save.rs:48-50` and `crates/tank_core/src/save.rs:76-82` migrate schema-v2 saves by rescaling dissolved totals onto net water volume, but they never reseed `state.stability_tracker` afterward. If an older save omits that field, serde falls back to `StabilityTracker::default` (`crates/tank_core/src/types/biology.rs:204-224`), so the first daily `update_stability_tracker` run will compare the loaded chemistry against hard-coded defaults instead of the migrated water state and can inject a bogus instability spike into shrimp health/mortality. Reseed the tracker after migration/loading with the migrated `state.water` and `state.water_volume_l()`.
amendments.rationale: This is a user-visible behavioral regression for legacy saves: chemistry migration succeeds, but the first simulated day can still apply false stress because the tracker baseline is stale.

amendments.body: `crates/tank_core/src/systems/plant_growth.rs:8-13` converts the plant half-saturation parameters to mg/L, but `crates/tank_core/src/systems/plant_growth.rs:60-61` then applies those mg/L constants to `substrate_n`/`substrate_p`, and `crates/tank_core/src/systems/plant_growth.rs:356-369` shows those substrate values are still raw mg totals. That unit mismatch makes substrate limitation almost always saturate whenever the bed has any meaningful charge, and it still scales with absolute substrate mass instead of a normalized compartment quantity. Root-feeding growth is therefore no longer volume/footprint invariant in the substrate path. Either keep the substrate side on the legacy total-based constants for now or add a normalized substrate helper before using the new mg/L thresholds there.
amendments.rationale: The water-column path was normalized, but the substrate path was not. As written, rooted plants can get materially incorrect limitation factors and tank-size-dependent behavior.

payload.summary: Reviewed the helper/net-volume refactor and related migrations, read the main changed implementation files end-to-end, and ran `cargo test`. I found 2 correctness gaps: legacy-save migration does not reseed the stability tracker baseline, and plant substrate limitation now mixes mg/L half-saturation constants with raw substrate totals.
